The Doctor has amazing English, as well as dentistry skills. (Worked alone throughout - very impressed)
Had a 1st experience today, first time I've been to a dentist who talked me through everything. She (the Doctor) advised what was wrong and the possible solutions.
Today was  my right side, deep, and i mean a deep and thorough clean as I had decay on a back tooth.
I was shown what the Dr was dound via a mirror, and i was impressed how deep the Dr was going.
A few more trips and I should be there abouts.
Medicine was given to sooth as well as fight the bacteria in the issue I had.

Sorry, no pics as I am not great with dentists, but will ensure I het some on my next visit to update.
Highly Recommended.
Definitely the best dental clinic in Pattaya. Price = quality 100% The doctor understands and speaks English. The lightest hand in work 🙌 I recommend this place …
